title: runtime: implement cross-precision compatibility shim + latency-safety prober for FlashAttention v2/v3
creator: Maya Singh
description: We need a lightweight compatibility shim that allows the runtime to route requests between FlashAttention v2 and v3 kernels without causing oscillation or tail-latency regressions. The shim will be quantization-aware, support per-sequence-length bucket heuristics, and include a latency-safety prober that validates rollout decisions against observed p95/p99 delta thresholds. This ticket covers design, microbench harness, telemetry hooks, and a staged rollout plan with automatic rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Shim toggles per-worker between FA v2 and FA v3 based on stable telemetry windows
No increase >5% in p95 latency for top 10% of production routes during a canary when using shim-enabled rollout
Fallback hysteresis prevents kernel oscillation for workloads with mixed sequence lengths
Quantized models (int8/4-bit) pick compatible kernels or fall back gracefully without correctness errors
Comprehensive unit and integration tests + perf regression test in CI harness
steps_to_reproduce: Deploy shim to a canary worker pool and set policy to prefer v3 for dense short sequences
Run benchmark suite with mixed sequence-length distribution (8/64/2048) and 50% quantized models
Observe kernel selection logs and p95/p99 latency in telemetry dashboard over a 30 minute window
Trigger prober failure scenario by injecting a 15% synthetic latency delta for v3 and validate automatic rollback
testing_plan: Microbenchmark harness: per-shape latency and memory peak for v2/v3/quantized variants (automated)
Canary traffic: 1% traffic for 2 hours, automated SLA checks against p50/p95/p99
Chaos testing: GPU OOM and kernel-launch failures simulated in staging
Regression job: nightly head-to-head against baseline for top 20 customer routes
rollout_plan: Phase 0: unit tests + local microbench (dev machines)
Phase 1: staging rollout on a small fleet with telemetry gating
Phase 2: 1% production canary for 2 hours; if gates pass, increase to 10% over 24h
Phase 3: gradual ramp to 100% with adaptive batching enabled; automatic rollback on threshold breach
Rollback criteria: >5% p95 regression or >0.5% increase in error-rate or any correctness mismatch
